layout_and_spacing.strategy: The Tetris Grid (Bento Grid Mode A) and Swiss asymmetry.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-6, p-8, p-12, p-24, p-32 (Generous padding)

hero.structure: Relative container with hero image as background. Text must NOT be centered. Left-aligned heavy typography. Call to Action stands out.
hero.instructions: Use the hero_chess_king image. Provide a massive H1. Add a dev login toggle and a Google auth button.

bento_features.style: Glassmorphism & Neumorphism blend. 1px inner stroke border-white/10. bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl.

coach_persona.style: Cinematic. Use the coach_eyes portrait. Deep emotional connection.
coach_persona.quote_style: Massive serif quote text. text-4xl sm:text-5xl italic text-gray-200.
coach_persona.instructions: Place the coach eyes image on the right or background with heavy black fade. Add brutal quote: 'You didn't lose over many mistakes. You lost in one moment of inattention.'

buttons.primary: bg-[#722F37] hover:bg-[#8B3A44] text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-none border border-[#722F37] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 hover:border-white/50 text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-none backdrop-blur-md transition-all

images.description: Ultra-realistic macro photography of a black chess king piece. Use as full hero background with left-to-right dark gradient overlay.
Intense piercing eyes of the Indian AI coach. Use in the 'Meet the Coach' section with heavy black fading.
Deep wine red and obsidian black fluid texture. Use as a subtle background for the 'Chess DNA' feature card.
Chess board with pieces set up. Use in 'The Lab' or 'Community Training' feature blocks.
Abstract golden curves on black. Use as a subtle section divider or accent image behind stats.

motion_and_effects.scroll: MANDATORY use of smooth scrolling if setting up the layout. Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered fades and translations.
motion_and_effects.interactions: Buttons MUST have a sharp scaling effect or inner border glow on hover. Cards must have a 1px border shimmer or slight translateY hover state.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white/off-white text over dark backgrounds meets APCA standards. Use overlays and text-shadow if placed over images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, links, and forms must have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="google-auth-button"').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium dark-mode landing page focusing on the brutally honest 'Indian AI Coach' persona.
Use custom pure HTML/Tailwind for the layout instead of generic Shadcn cards to break standard SaaS grids.
Apply 'Cormorant Garamond' (serif) for headings to evoke luxury and history, and 'Outfit' (sans) for crisp UI text.
Must include a fixed/sticky navigation with a 'Crystal Glass' blur effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10).
Include standard auth components: Google Auth login, Dev Login toggle, Theme toggle.

Section 1: Hero using 'hero_chess_king'. Section 2: 'Meet the Coach' using 'coach_eyes' and the brutal truth quote. Section 3: 'The Lab & DNA' Bento Grid using 'bg_wine_texture' and 'chess_board_game'. Section 4: Social Proof / Stats in huge typography.
Keep borders sharp (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). No playful bubbles. This is high-stakes chess coaching.
Do NOT use 'Inter', teal, or standard SaaS blue. Rely on #050505 (Void Black), #722F37 (Wine Red), and #CBA135 (Gold).
